ValidationRule.description: Required Financial details fields for : Unsecured - New Loan/Finance
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !ISPICKVAL(Case__r.cc_Control_Type__c, 'STP'), ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Product__c, 'Unsecured'), ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Business_Nature_Type__c, 'New Loan/Finance'), OR( AND(ISCHANGED(cx_ln_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c),ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, 'Accept')), AND(ISCHANGED(cx_ln_Credit_Approval_Result__c),ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Credit_Approval_Result__c, 'Approve')) ), OR( NOT(cx_ln_isScheduleGenerated__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Basic_Salary__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Fixed_Allowances__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Variable_Allowances__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Business_Income__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Total_Approved_Income__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Gross_Income__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Total_Obligations__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Current_DBR__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Approved_Loan_Amount__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Approved_Duration_Months__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_ApprovedInterestProfitRateReducing__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Approved_Installment_Amount__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Approved_Maturity_Date__c), ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Approved_Insurance_Premium__c, ''), ISNULL(cx_ln_Approved_First_installment_date__c), ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_ApprovedProcessing_Fee_Type__c,''), ISNULL(cx_ln_Approved_Cash_in_Hand__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_Final_DBR__c), ISNULL(cx_ln_APR__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please Provide all the required information in financial details tab and generate the schedule before giving a result.
